caption: The drawing depicts a wooden object composed primarily of brown tones, with varying shades used to illustrate texture and detail on the wood, giving it a polished appearance. The structure includes a central vertical spindle with spiral grooves, rising from a round, thick base supported by three splayed legs. About halfway up the spindle, a horizontal circular ring is attached. Further up, there is a crossbar with two upright cylindrical candle holders at each end, each holding a white candle with a black base. Some hand-written measurements are present around the object, indicating lengths of 15 inches for the top crossbar and 14 inches for the width of the ring below it. The background is plain, off-white, and there are no other objects or elements in the composition.
title: Cobbler's Table with Candle Stand
